'''Xie Sishen''' ({{zh|c=解思深|p=Xiè Sīshēn}}; 18 February 1942 – 2 November 2022) was a Chinese physicist, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Wang Guangrong ({{lang|zh|王光荣}}) |url=https://news.sina.com.cn/o/2004-05-28/08472651383s.shtml |script-title=zh:解思深受聘国家纳米科学中心主任首席科学家 |work=sina |date=28 May 2004 |access-date=4 November 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> 

==Biography==
Xie was born in [[Qingdao]], [[Shandong]], on 18 February 1942.<ref name="xie">{{cite news |author1=Jiang Ziwen ({{lang|zh|蒋子文}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_20582016 |script-title=zh:中科院院士、物理学家解思深逝世，享年80岁 |work=thepaper |date=3 November 2022 |access-date=4 November 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> After graduating from [[Peking University]] in 1965, he was despatched to [[Ningxia]] Iron and Steel Works as a technician.<ref name="xie"/> After resuming the college entrance examination, in 1978, he was admitted to the Graduate School of Chinese Academy of Sciences, where he received his master's degree in 1982 and his doctor's degree in 1983 under the supervision of academicians [[Lu Shanxue]] and [[Liang Jingkui]]. He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in November 1984.<ref name="xie"/> From 1984 to 1986 he was a postdoctoral fellow at the [[University of Colorado]].

Xie returned to China in 1993 and continued to work at the Institute of Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences. In 2013, he was recruited as dean of the School of Science, [[Renmin University of China]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Yang Mo ({{lang|zh|杨默}}) |url=https://news.ruc.edu.cn/archives/45762 |script-title=zh:解思深院士受聘中国人民大学理学院院长 |work=ruc.edu.cn |date=17 January 2013 |access-date=4 November 2022 |language=zh |archive-date=4 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221104134851/https://news.ruc.edu.cn/archives/45762 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

On 2 November 2022, he died of an illness in [[Beijing]], at the age of 80.<ref name="xie"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 1989 State Natural Science Award (First Class) for the discovery of high tc oxide system<ref name="xie"/>
* 1991 State Natural Science Award (Third Class) for the synthesis, correlation and crystal structure of oxide superconductors at liquid nitrogen temperature<ref name="xie"/>
* 2000 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="xie"/>
* 2001 3rd [[Zhou Peiyuan]] Physics Prize<ref name="xie"/>
* 2002 State Natural Science Award (Second Class) for the preparation, structure and properties of aligned carbon nanotubes<ref name="xie"/>
* 2003 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="xie"/>
* 2004 Fellow of [[The Academy of Sciences for the Developing World]] (TWAS)<ref name="xie"/>
